press_references.value: Acwa signs joint development agreement with PT GARAM for Indonesia's first utility-scale integrated seawater desalination and industrial salt project

partnership_announcements.description: Acwa and PT GARAM signed a Joint Development Agreement to develop Indonesia's first utility-scale integrated seawater desalination and industrial salt facility in Manyar, East Java. The approximately USD 400 million project is designed to produce 62,500 cubic meters of desalinated water daily and 500,000 tons of industrial salt annually.

press_references.value: Acwa Power Philippines advances 500-MW PV project

partnership_announcements.description: Acwa Power Philippines signed a lease agreement with the Bases Conversion and Development Authority for a 500-hectare site in New Clark City to develop a 500-MW solar PV and battery storage facility, supporting the Philippines’ clean energy transition and industrial investment goals.

press_references.value: ACWA to Invest Up to US$20 Billion in Uzbekistan Energy

partnership_announcements.description: ACWA Power and the Republic of Uzbekistan are engaged in a long-term strategic partnership focused on large-scale renewable energy generation, transmission infrastructure, and green hydrogen pilot projects.

press_references.value: Morocco commits to green hydrogen as a new energy link with Europe

partnership_announcements.description: ACWA Power has been selected as the key developer of a renewable hydrogen project in Morocco, positioning the Saudi energy company as a strategic partner in Morocco’s emerging green hydrogen and green steel export industry.

press_references.value: Mideast Stocks: Gulf stocks rise on firmer oil, earnings; Mideast tensions in focus

partnership_announcements.description: ACWA Power announced it signed an energy conversion and water purchase agreement with an estimated deal value of about $4.1 billion, expanding its project portfolio in Saudi Arabia.

press_references.value: Kuwait moves to secure power supply as Al-Zour North deal with ACWA power nears signing

partnership_announcements.description: Kuwait’s Public-Private Partnership Projects Authority and ACWA Power are preparing to sign a long-term power purchase agreement for the Al-Zour North Power Plant expansion (phases two and three), formalizing a public-private partnership for power generation.

press_references.value: Acwa Power, Consortium Achieve $8.2 Bln Financial Close To Develop 15 GW Of Renewables In KSA

partnership_announcements.description: Acwa Power, Badeel, and Aramco subsidiary SAPCO formed a new partnership to jointly develop 15 GW of renewable energy projects in Saudi Arabia backed by $8.2 billion in financing.

press_references.value: Saudi Arabia's Acwa Power

partnership_announcements.description: Acwa Power, Badeel and Saudi Aramco formed a partnership for a $6 billion program aimed at developing 70% of Saudi Arabia’s renewable energy targets by 2030 to supply Saudi Power Procurement Company.

press_references.value: ACWA Power and L&T Unite for Saudi’s Yanbu Green Hydrogen Megaproject

partnership_announcements.description: ACWA Power and Larsen & Toubro signed an MoU to collaborate on renewables and grid infrastructure for the Yanbu Green Hydrogen Hub, covering solar PV, wind, BESS, and high‑voltage substations and transmission, with a potential EPC contract to follow.

press_references.value: ACWA Power awards Técnicas Reunidas, China’s Sipnopec contract for Yanbu Green Hydrogen Hub

partnership_announcements.description: ACWA Power awarded a 10-month front-end engineering design (FEED) contract for the Yanbu Green Hydrogen Hub to a consortium of Técnicas Reunidas and Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering. The consortium will design a facility targeting 400,000 tons of green hydrogen production annually, with commercial operations expected by 2030.

about_short_description.short_description: ACWA Power is a developer, investor, co-owner and operator of a portfolio of power generation and renewable energy.

product.name: Power Generation
product.description: Development, investment, co-ownership, and operation of power-generation assets that supply reliable electricity to utilities, communities, and industrial customers.

product.name: Renewable Energy
product.description: Utility-scale renewable energy projects, including solar and wind generation, developed and operated to supply low-carbon electricity.

product.name: Desalinated Water Solutions
product.description: Development and operation of desalination infrastructure that produces treated water for utilities, municipalities, communities, and industrial users.

product.name: Green Hydrogen and Green Ammonia
product.description: Development of renewable-powered green hydrogen projects and related green ammonia production for clean-fuel and energy-export applications.

identifier.value: Energy and Water Project Development and Investment

product.name: Energy and Water Project Development and Investment
product.description: End-to-end development, investment, and co-ownership of large-scale energy and water infrastructure projects, from planning and financing through delivery and operation.

product.name: ACWA Operations
product.description: Operational management for energy and water assets, supporting the continuous, safe, and reliable delivery of electricity and desalinated water.
